gaps.construct: nine arguments all defaulting to None (tzinfo to True), fold keyword-only
gaps.description: No defaults or keyword arguments, so the common call dt.replace(day=1) becomes a nine-argument call with eight 'nothing'/'Keep' placeholders, in positional order. This defeats the readability goal at every call site.

gaps.construct: type(self)(...) builds an instance of the receiver's runtime class
gaps.description: Scribe has no subclassing and no way to name 'the same type as this argument', so a subclass of datetime gets a plain Datetime back.

gaps.construct: replace is a method on datetime (self)
gaps.description: There are no methods; self becomes an ordinary first parameter. Workable, but the method's place in the class is lost.

gaps.construct: tzinfo is an abstract base class that user code subclasses
gaps.description: No interface or trait construct, so TzInfo is declared as an opaque type.

gaps.construct: if year is None: year = self.year (nine times)
gaps.description: No 'value or default' expression for a maybe, and choose is a statement, so each field needs a var plus a choose that sets it in both branches: 6 lines for each Python 2-line if, about 55 body lines for 18.

gaps.construct: tzinfo=True sentinel, because None is itself a valid value meaning 'no time zone'
gaps.description: Distinguishing 'not given' from 'given as nothing' needs a declared choice type (Keep / Replace with a maybe TzInfo). Nested 'maybe maybe TzInfo' is not shown in the doc.

gaps.construct: binding a choice payload under a new name
gaps.description: Example 5 binds payloads by their field name only ('when Circle with radius'); renaming in a 'when' line ('when Replace with new_tzinfo_value') is not shown.

gaps.construct: an operation with nine parameters and no natural label words
gaps.description: The doc never shows more than four parameters; separating parameter names with 'and' is borrowed from record construction and is a guess.

invented_syntax: to replace self with year and month and ... and fold  (and-separated parameter list in an operation header)
when Replace with new_tzinfo_value  (renamed payload binding)
notes: This is the strongest case in my set for an expression-level default for maybe values (something like 'year or else year of self'), and for named or defaulted arguments; together they would make the body nine lines. Python's own constructor checks the ranges, so the translation adds no contract; a Datetime type with refinement fields (month 1 through 12) would remove the TypeError/ValueError failures but would be an invented specification.
